item.title: How Jensen Huang’s Secret Led to His Downfall at Nvidia
item.description: Nvidia’s leader said his relationship with a female customer was just about business. But what he was concealing eventually led to his resignation from the company he created.

item.title: The Jensen Huang Scandal Has Shocked Even Scandal-Prone Silicon Valley
item.description: As Jensen Huang abruptly departs, the tech community grapples with an eternal question: Why do the smartest and most successful men so often act so stupidly?
item.dc:creator: David Streitfeld
item.media:description: The revelation that Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang changed the chatter in Silicon Valley from soaring I.P.O.s to tawdry affairs.

item.title: Tech Leaders Rally Behind Jensen Huang
item.description: In social media posts and letters to Nvidia’s board, Mr. Huang’s billionaire peers described him as a singular leader who could not be replaced at Nvidia.
item.dc:creator: Kalley Huang
item.media:description: “Jensen drove supply chain brilliantly at Nvidia, but many of those deals were a handshake with Jensen, not a written contract,” Elon Musk said of Jensen Huang in a social media post.

item.title: Inside Microsoft’s Rush to Get Back Online After a Global Outage
item.description: A prolonged outage left many without email and other services, the most recent reminder that the world’s technological underpinnings rely on just a few companies.
item.dc:creator: Karen Weise
item.media:credit: Grant Hindsley for The New York Times
item.media:description: Microsoft acknowledged that about 20 different services were impaired by the outage.

item.title: Apple Addresses Outages Affecting Apple Pay, iCloud and Apps

item.title: A More Precise Clock Is on Its Way
item.description: The optical atomic clock, which scientists say would be off by about a second over 14 billion years, is soon expected to become a primary reference.
item.dc:creator: Penelope Colston
item.category: International Bureau of Weights and Measures
National Institute of Standards and Technology
item.media:credit: Juho Kuva for The New York Times
item.media:description: To measure time, optical clocks use a laser to probe atoms that have been isolated and cooled to a near standstill. The photo shows compact lasers made by the Finnish company Vexlum, which is working with Menlo Systems on commercial production of an optical clock.

item.title: Madison Huang, Jensen Huang’s Daughter, Became a Powerful Force at Nvidia
item.description: Installed as her father’s de facto chief of staff, Jensen Huang’s daughter alienated top executives. Now her lingering role poses a test for interim C.E.O. Colette Kress.

item.title: How Sam Bankman-Fried Lost Out on a $35 Billion Jackpot From Anthropic

item.title: Apple Was Late to the Video Podcast Boom. Now It’s Trying to Catch Up.

item.title: Fan Fiction Site AO3 Returns, and So Do Its Readers, in Droves

item.title: Microsoft’s Global Outage and Fixes: What We Know

item.title: Jensen Huang’s Resignation From Nvidia Worries the A.I. Start-Up World
